title: fix(app-shell): the record page shows a save's new values as soon as the save succeeds
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi929ETZMCBszLGoSpphXJcXA)_

Fixes #33827

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 记录页(含抽屉)保存成功后,直接用保存接口返回的那条记录更新页面上的字段,而不是等保存后的重新读取回来。重新读取照常进行,回来后整条替换。
- **为什么改:** 实测(CRM 示例):PATCH 的返回里已经是新记录,但页面只认 `findOne` 重新读取的结果,而这次读取和保存后的另外五六个请求一起排队,staging 上要几秒,于是「已更新」提示出来时字段还是旧值。
- **风险与回滚:** 只动 `@object-ui/app-shell` 的记录页视图和一个新的小函数,无 spec、无服务端改动,不多发请求。保存没改的关联字段保留已展开的名字;保存改了的关联字段先显示新 id,重新读取回来后显示名字。回滚 = revert。
- **先看:** `recordSaveEcho.ts` 的 `applySavedRecordEcho`(哪些键可以被返回值覆盖);`RecordDetailView.tsx` 记录读取 effect 之后新增的 `onMutation` 订阅;测试 `RecordDetailView.timelineCount-28737.test.tsx` 末尾的 objectstack#33827 describe。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.timelineCount-28737.test.tsx`,预期 12/12 通过;在 app-crm 打开一个客户,编辑 → 改网站 → 更新,提示出现的同时页头「网站」已是新值。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The record page takes the save's own answer.** `RecordDetailView` subscribes to the adapter's `onMutation` for an `update` of the record it shows and lays the event's `record` (the server's answer to the write, field-masked like any read) over the record it holds, through the new `applySavedRecordEcho`. The adapter emits that event before the write's promise resolves, in the same dispatch that invalidates the record on the bus, so the page holds the saved record by the time the edit dialog's `onSuccess` shows the success toast.
- **The re-read is unchanged.** The record-load effect still re-runs on `recordInvalidationNonce` and replaces the record whole when its `$expand` read answers; objectstack#30082's stream re-read (objectstack#30035) is untouched.
- **What the answer may change** (`applySavedRecordEcho`): only an answer naming this record (`id` or `_id`) is taken; nothing is laid over a record that has not loaded; a key the answer leaves out keeps the held value; a relation held EXPANDED that the answer gives back as the same bare id keeps the expanded value, so an untouched lookup never flips from its name to its id; a relation the save changed takes the answer's value; an answer that changes nothing hands back the held object itself (ui/AGENTS.md #10).

## Why

Measured on `examples/app-crm` (fresh stack, Console from `ui/apps/console` via Vite so it serves this branch's src, Playwright, the edit dialog on a `crm_account` record page):

1. The `PATCH /api/v1/data/crm_account/ID` answer already carries the full saved record (`{ object, id, record: { … website: NEW_VALUE … } }`).
2. The page drew the field values only from `pageRecord`, which only the record-load effect's re-read (`GET /api/v1/data/crm_account?populate=…&filter=["id","=",ID]`) replaces. That read goes out on the invalidation together with `/page`, `field-access`, `sys_audit_log`, approvals and two `security/explain` asks.
3. Delaying each post-save read alone by 2 s pins the visible value on that one read: the `populate` read delayed ⇒ the saved value at 2822 ms after the click; `/page`, `field-access` or the plain `GET …/ID` delayed ⇒ 1119–1273 ms. So the stale window is that read's latency, which on the staging free tier is seconds.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in the shared real-adapter harness `RecordDetailView.timelineCount-28737.test.tsx` (StrictMode, held transport, the console's mutation bridge mounted beside the view), plus a unit file for the merge rule:

- `the record page: the saved value is drawn when the save resolves, with every re-read still held` and `the drawer: …`: open, settle, `ds.update(OBJECT, 'c1', { name: 'Renamed' })`, release ONLY the PATCH and await the update's promise (the moment the dialog's success toast fires); the re-reads it triggered are asserted present and all still unanswered, and `Renamed` is on screen.
- `a save to another record of the object leaves this one as it is`.
- `recordSaveEcho.test.ts` (7 cases): saved values taken and omitted keys kept; an expanded relation kept for the same id (single and multi); a changed relation taken; identity kept for an equal answer; an answer naming another record, no id, `undefined` or an array taken as nothing; `_id`; nothing laid over an unloaded record.
- **Forced test edit:** the harness's PATCH answer echoed `id: 'c1'` for every write; it now echoes the id the PATCH path names, so the `c2` case answers as the server would.

<details><summary>Runs, ablation and the wider suite (head 63f0286a)</summary>

- Harness + unit file: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 19 passed (19)` (the 9 existing objectstack#28737 / #29878 / #30035 cases plus the 3 above, and the 7 unit cases).
- Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor `setPageRecord((held: unknown) => applySavedRecordEcho(…))` hit 1 → 0, replaced with `void applySavedRecordEcho;`; restored blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): both save pins red, `AssertionError: expected 'ContactContact c1Contact c1ContactEdi…' to contain 'Renamed'`, `Tests 2 failed | 10 passed (12)`; the objectstack#30035 pins stay green in the ablated run. ui vitest resolves `@object-ui/*` to `src/`, so no build sits between mutation and run.
- Every test file under `ui/packages/app-shell/src` and `ui/apps/console/src` that names `RecordDetailView`, `recordPagePayload` or `recordSaveEcho` (242 files, selected by `grep -rlE`): `Test Files 242 passed (242)`, `Tests 1961 passed (1961)` (lock VERDICT command-exit 0). Run at 92ea4dd8; 63f0286a only drops an explicit `any` on the new setter line, and the two pin files were re-run on 63f0286a. The rest of Test UI is CI's.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the four touched files from `ui/`: 0 errors (pre-existing warnings only; none on the added lines). `pnpm run check:new-line-citations` (ui): `0 new citation(s)`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Real browser, `examples/app-crm`** (`objectstack dev --fresh`, Console via Vite on this branch's src, admin, `crm_account` 「Initech」, edit dialog → Website → Update; times from the click; every post-save read held 2 s by Playwright routing unless said):
  - Before (base 895783a1, unmodified): toast at 573 ms, the new Website link on the page at **2832 ms**.
  - After, record page (reads held 4 s): toast at 713 ms, the new link already on the page at 711 ms; 600 ms later, reads still on the wire, header Website shows the new value and Account Owner still reads 「Dev Admin」 (its expanded name kept).
  - After, drawer (`?recordId=` over the list): the link is on the page when the toast shows (counted at the toast, 1 of 1).
  - After, no delay: toast 752 ms, value 723 ms.
- **A lookup the save changes** shows the answer's bare value until the re-read answers with its expansion; it never shows the previous related record's name. A field the answer leaves out (none did on ObjectStack, whose update answers the whole row) keeps its held value until the re-read.
- **Observed, not changed:** about 350 ms pass between the PATCH response and the adapter's mutation event / the toast in the Playwright timeline; both move together, so the page and the toast still agree. Not investigated further.
- Seat 2's cards objectstack#33826 (recent items after delete) and objectstack#33830 (activity boolean display) carry no live claim; this PR touches only `RecordDetailView.tsx`, the harness test, the new `recordSaveEcho.ts` pair and the changeset.

## Verification

Gates from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on 63f0286a (change set: 5 paths vs merge base 895783a1e): **38 derived, 38 run, all exit 0**; `dispatch-gates --ran`: "38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero …)".
